instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Record what my AI decided, why, what to do next and how we will know it worked", and give it decision_id; decision.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:make-the-decision and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Once every row of the decision's method has an answer: decision is { option_id (one of the options), reason, next_action, success_measure, evidence_refs, move?, and every decision field the decision asks for }. A decided decision changes only after a failed result: the decision it had moves to decision_history. Returns what to do now and how to say it.

4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: decision (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-revision (records:read, records:write); decision-step (records:read, records:write); decision-call (records:write); decision-evidence (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-answered-step (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-option (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-candidate (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-report (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-carried-out (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-history (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-cited-pursuit (records:read, records:list, records:write); decision-method (records:read, records:write); decision-part (records:read, records:write); decision-refs (records:read, records:write); pursuit (records:read, records:list); list (records:read); list-view (records:read); record:method-row (records:list); method-answer (records:list).
